stories.headline: Meta Settles the Teen Harm Case for Up to $17 Billion — and Rewrites Instagram's Defaults
stories.key_takeaway: Meta ended a landmark state child-safety trial midway through week two by agreeing to pay up to $17 billion and accept court-ordered defaults on Instagram and Facebook for every U.S. user under 18, with a third of the money contingent on TikTok and YouTube signing similar terms.

pull_quote.text: Meta intentionally exploited kids for profit and then lied about it, claiming its products were safe when its own internal research confirmed the platforms were addictive and harmful.

stories.article_excerpt: Eight days into a trial that was supposed to run until October, Meta blinked. California AG Rob Bonta announced the deal Wednesday.

stories.headline: SoftBank Is Shopping a $20 Billion Bond to Refinance Its OpenAI Bet
stories.key_takeaway: SoftBank is sounding out banks on a $10B-$20B dollar-and-euro bond, potentially September and possibly Asia's largest corporate deal of 2026, to refinance the $40 billion bridge loan underwriting its roughly $65 billion OpenAI stake.

pull_quote.text: We think Arm has a solid credit profile but OpenAI is very weak. It's a startup with significant AI innovation risk and lots of competition.

stories.article_excerpt: SoftBank Group is asking the global bond market to shoulder what its banks would rather hand off. The conglomerate is in talks with lenders.

stories.headline: Anthropic Will Tell Investors Its Market Is Worth $30 Trillion. Its Own Forecast Needs 0.65% of It.
stories.key_takeaway: Anthropic's record $30 trillion TAM is not a revenue forecast but a denominator, built by pricing human labor rather than software spending, and it exists to make the company's own $195 billion 2028 target look like a rounding error.

pull_quote.text: With things like Claude and the way it writes code, you could argue it's replacing the work that humans do end-to-end, and so the TAM for those products is essentially the labor market for that work output.
pull_quote.role: Co-founder and General Partner, Backed VC

data_points.label: Revenue of all 191 S&P 1500 tech firms

stories.article_excerpt: There is a number in Anthropic's forthcoming IPO pitch that no auditor will ever sign off on and no accounting standard defines.

stories.headline: Amazon Is Shutting Mechanical Turk on September 30. The AI It Helped Train Took Its Job.
stories.key_takeaway: Amazon is closing Mechanical Turk on September 30 after 21 years, retiring the crowdsourcing marketplace that supplied the labeled data behind ImageNet and modern AI, as models now do the cheap classification work.

pull_quote.text: There's some people that still pretty much still do it full time. They're concerned now.

stories.article_excerpt: Amazon spent 21 years running a marketplace built on one premise: there are still things people do better than computers.

stories.headline: Moonshot Wants 30% of the Revenue. Microsoft, Amazon and Google Are Listening.
stories.key_takeaway: Moonshot AI is asking Microsoft, Amazon and Google for up to 30% of all Kimi K3 revenue on their clouds, testing whether commercial demand for a top-tier Chinese open-weight model outweighs the risk of partnering with a company Washington may blacklist.

pull_quote.text: Open source is not open season on American IP. When firms conduct covert, industrial-scale distillation attacks that cross the line into IP theft, sanctions and Entity List designations will be on the table.

data_points.label: Revenue share sought from the clouds

stories.article_excerpt: Moonshot AI has spent the past month being accused by senior US officials of stealing American intellectual property.

stories.headline: Tencent-Backed Enflame Opens Books on a $892 Million Shanghai IPO
stories.key_takeaway: Enflame's $892 million STAR Market listing is the sharpest test yet of whether China's AI chip rally rests on fundamentals or on Nvidia's forced exit, given a 1.2 billion yuan loss and 83.8% revenue concentration in its own backer.

pull_quote.text: Conceding an entire market the size of China probably does not make a lot of strategic sense, so I think that has already largely backfired.

stories.article_excerpt: Enflame Technology, the Shanghai AI chip designer Tencent has spent years quietly building, will open its books on September 2.

stories.headline: Mistral Sells Sovereignty Twice: A Hundreds-of-Millions Deal With Saudi Arabia's HUMAIN
stories.key_takeaway: Mistral has extended its European sovereign-AI pitch to Saudi Arabia in a hundreds-of-millions-euro framework with PIF-owned HUMAIN, trading Arabic frontier models and regulated-market access for Gulf compute capacity it cannot build fast enough at home.

pull_quote.text: AI is an energy game. We have power, energy affordability and abundance, connectivity, land, and water. We have all that it needs to translate Saudi Arabia to the world's largest AI token exporter.

stories.article_excerpt: Mistral has spent two years telling Europe that renting intelligence from foreign powers is a form of surrender.

stories.headline: IBM's Granite 4.2 Bets That Enterprises Want a 30B Agent Model They Can Own
stories.key_takeaway: IBM shipped Apache 2.0 reasoning models at 3B, 8B and 30B trained with agentic RL in live code, terminal and search environments, betting enterprise buyers will trade a capability gap against Qwen for weights they own outright.

pull_quote.text: Qwen 3.8 27B, especially, beats the Granite models across the board, especially when it comes to coding, where the IBM models deliver inconsistent results overall.
pull_quote.role: Senior Editor for AI, The New Stack

stories.article_excerpt: The most interesting number in IBM's Granite 4.2 release is not a benchmark score. It is zero: zero dollars, zero licensing gate.

stories.headline: Google Points Gemini Enterprise at Big Law — and at Harvey's Business Model
stories.key_takeaway: Google Cloud launched Gemini Enterprise for Legal in preview with Cleary Gottlieb, Freshfields, Weil and Williams & Connolly as design partners, connecting to Harvey, Legora, Thomson Reuters, iManage and Relativity while undercutting them on price.

pull_quote.text: General-purpose AI, however capable, does not meet that standard on its own. Foundational model intelligence is necessary. For legal work, it is nowhere near sufficient.

data_points.label: Gemini Enterprise seat price per month
Valuation Harvey is reportedly raising at
Court rulings on fabricated AI citations

stories.article_excerpt: Google Cloud spent Tuesday doing the thing legal technology has been bracing for since the first lawyer got sanctioned.

stories.headline: Claude Now Carries One Memory Across Chat and Cowork. There Is No Way to Split It.
stories.key_takeaway: Anthropic merged Claude chat and Cowork into a single editable memory store on August 25, eliminating agent re-briefing but leaving users no way to separate work and personal context short of running two accounts.

pull_quote.text: Anthropic told us there's no option to separate Claude Chat and Cowork's memories since they now use a shared system.

stories.article_excerpt: The most tedious part of using an AI agent has never been the agent. It has been the briefing.

stories.headline: Microsoft Will Put Saudi Arabia's Arabic Models Inside Foundry and Copilot
stories.key_takeaway: HUMAIN and Microsoft announced plans, not products: ALLAM is intended for Microsoft Foundry and eventually Microsoft 365 Copilot with no ship date, while the concrete piece is embedding HUMAIN engineers alongside Microsoft's Forward Deployed Engineers inside Saudi customer environments.

pull_quote.text: This collaboration begins with plans to bring ALLAM to a number of key Microsoft AI solutions, and this is just the first step.

stories.article_excerpt: Two days after selling a piece of its sovereign AI ambitions to Paris, Riyadh sold a distribution channel to Redmond.

stories.headline: A German Broker Just Let ChatGPT and Claude Place Trades for a Million Customers
stories.key_takeaway: Scalable Capital has wired ChatGPT, Claude and Grok directly into a regulated European brokerage via MCP, giving over one million clients prompt-driven access to 60 billion euros in assets while keeping a human confirmation step on every trade.

pull_quote.text: Agentic Investing represents the greatest technological shift in financial technology since internet banking. By opening our platform, we are setting the benchmark for how humans, AI, and the capital markets interact.

data_points.label: Sessions Claude beat humans in Elm Wealth test

stories.article_excerpt: Type buy 10 shares of Siemens into ChatGPT and, until this week, nothing happened. On Tuesday that changed.

stories.headline: OpenAI's Jalapeno Chip Claims 1.9x Blackwell's Work Per Watt, On OpenAI's Own Numbers
stories.key_takeaway: OpenAI's first custom inference ASIC posts 1.5x to 1.9x better throughput per kilowatt than Nvidia's Blackwell racks in benchmarks OpenAI ran itself, but the comparison excludes newer Nvidia hardware and rests on normalization choices that need scrutiny.

pull_quote.text: Usually first generation chips aren't competitive, but OpenAI is beating Nvidia Blackwell and even Rubin.

data_points.label: Claimed throughput per kilowatt vs GB300

stories.article_excerpt: Nine days after Nvidia agreed to backstop financing for an OpenAI-leased campus in Ohio, OpenAI published numbers on its own silicon.

stories.headline: Samsung Put the Math Inside the Memory. It Claims an Eightfold Bandwidth Jump.
stories.key_takeaway: Samsung's LPDDR5X-PIM embeds MAC engines in all 16 DRAM banks to hit 614 GB/s internal bandwidth and triple LLM token throughput on edge silicon, but its fate hinges on JEDEC standardization and a named customer rather than the benchmarks.

pull_quote.text: This one feels like one where a large customer is going to have to come in and say this is needed, implement it, and then it will get widely adopted.

data_points.label: PIM run time vs 12.3 sec conventional
Memory share of accelerator component cost

stories.article_excerpt: A conventional LPDDR5X-9600 package moves data to a processor at 76.8 GB/s. Samsung says it can do better without leaving the die.

stories.headline: An AI Read 500,000 DNA Sequences and Finally Pinned Down Biology's Fuzziest Gene Switch
stories.key_takeaway: UC San Diego researchers measured the activity of about 500,000 initiator variants and trained models that, for the first time, quantitatively predict where transcription starts, finding an active initiator in roughly 60% of focused human promoters.

pull_quote.text: These AI models were found to provide, for the first time, strong predictions of the presence or absence of the initiator in human genes, and were thus able to decode the DNA base sequence pattern of the initiator.
pull_quote.role: Professor of Molecular Biology, UC San Diego

data_points.label: Focused human promoters with an initiator

stories.article_excerpt: Biologists have known about the initiator since 1989. What they have never had is a reliable way to find one.

stories.headline: Bill Gates Wants Some Jobs Legally Off-Limits to AI. He Floated 40 Percent.
stories.key_takeaway: Bill Gates is asking governments to legally reserve certain occupations for humans and tax AI tokens and robots, admitting he cannot get the protected share above 40 percent even in an extreme scenario.

pull_quote.text: In a very extreme form of it, I could imagine 40% of jobs could initially be reserved for humans. But that's as high as I can get.

data_points.label: Words in the Gates Notes essay
Year Gates first proposed a robot tax

stories.article_excerpt: Bill Gates spent five decades arguing that technology, on balance, makes the world better. On Wednesday he published a caveat.

stories.headline: London's Robotaxi Launch Slips. Waymo, Wayve and Baidu Are Waiting on a Document.
stories.key_takeaway: London's fully driverless robotaxi launch has slipped out of 2026 because Transport for London has not published the operator guidance companies need and the DVSA has approved zero vehicles under the new permit regime.

pull_quote.text: I do not think we are in a rush to get [the guidelines] out. There is a huge amount of work going on behind the scenes.
pull_quote.role: Director of Strategy, Transport for London

data_points.label: PHV licences TfL granted Wayve on Aug 5
Londoners on the Uber-Wayve interest list

stories.article_excerpt: London was supposed to be Europe's answer to Phoenix. Instead, three of the best-funded autonomous driving firms are waiting.

stories.headline: A Self-Hosted Git Server Bug Is Being Exploited. Federal Agencies Have Until Friday.
stories.key_takeaway: A CVSS 9.8 code injection flaw in self-hosted Gitea is under active exploitation and now carries a federal patch deadline, exposing the Git servers that increasingly feed and host AI coding agents.

pull_quote.text: An attacker with ordinary write access to a repository can execute arbitrary shell commands as the Gitea OS user.

stories.article_excerpt: A developer in Russia noticed their server's CPU had been pinned high for days. The hosting provider flagged it.
